# Libraries
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE)
#knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "D:/work/Bmori/mitochondria/new_mtDNA_phylo/figures/")
```

```{r libraries}
library (ape)
library (ggtree)
library (tidyverse)

```

# Input
```{r input}

tree <- read.tree("../phylo/Bombyx_mtDNA_new.treefile")
tree <- root(tree, outgroup = "NC_026518.1", resolve.root = TRUE, edgelabel = TRUE)

spec <- read_tsv("../input_data/Bombyx_new_mtDNA_spcies.tsv")
colnames(spec) <- c("label", "species")

spec_colors <- c(
  huttoni = "black",
  mandarina = "#6699CC",
  mori =  "#999933",
  p50T = "#117733",
  p50ma = "#AA4499"
)

```
# Initial Plotting
```{r plot}

p <- ggtree(tree, branch.length = "none") %<+% spec 

p$data <- p$data %>%
  mutate(
    boot   = ifelse(isTip, NA, suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub(".*/", "", label)))),
    supported = !isTip & boot >= 80
  )

p <- p +
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = species), size = 1) +
  geom_nodelab(aes(subset = supported, label = boot), size = 2, hjust = 1.3, vjust = -0.4) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(color=guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)) +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(face="italic"), legend.title = element_blank()) +
  scale_color_manual(values = spec_colors)

p


```


```{r output, eval = F}

ggsave(
  "Mt_phylo_new.tiff",
  plot   =p,
  device = ragg::agg_tiff,
  width  = 85, height = 160, units = "mm",
  res    = 300,
  compression = "lzw" 
)
```

# Revised Plotting

```{r}
spec_fills <- c(
  huttoni   = "black",
  mandarina = "#AAAAAA",
  mori      = "white",
  p50T      = "#0072B2",
  p50ma     = "#D55E00"
)

spec_shapes <- c(
  huttoni   = 21,  # circle
  mandarina = 21,  # circle
  mori      = 21,  # circle
  p50T      = 24,  # triangle
  p50ma     = 22   # square
)

```



```{r}
pnow <- p +
  geom_tippoint(
    aes(fill = species, shape = species),
    color = "black",
    size = 1.8,
    stroke = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = spec_fills) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = spec_shapes) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      nrow = 2,
      byrow = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(
        shape = unname(spec_shapes[names(spec_fills)]),
        color = "black",
        size = 3,
        stroke = 0.5
      )
    ),
    shape = "none"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(face = "italic"),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r, fig.height=7, fig.width=3}
plot(pnow)
```



```{r output}

ggsave(
  "Mt_phylo_revised.tiff",
  plot   =pnow,
  device = ragg::agg_tiff,
  width  = 85, height = 160, units = "mm",
  res    = 300,
  compression = "lzw" 
)
```
